title: Continue the actual hard-core pair response to a visible local pole
statement: At fixed g=1/5 and V=n_L-n_R,there exist r,epsilon>0 such that the upper-half-plane bare-pair and dressed-pair responses continue meromorphically to D(E,r). For real |eta|<epsilon they share one visible simple pole lambda(eta),holomorphic and even in eta,with lambda=E-s(E+i0)eta^2+O(eta^4) and Im lambda=-pi rho(E)eta^2+O(eta^4).

requires: Complete fixed-g ladder and exact physical hard-core compression
Bounded analytic bath deformation with transpose bilinear form and the proved positive dressed density
provides: Bounded holomorphic operators on a fixed Hilbert space,full complementary space and actual infinite-rank V retained
Simple isolated Riesz branch and matching of the actual upper physical germ;both bare and dressed pole coefficients stay nonzero
Threshold E<6 via block monotonicity;possible coincident harmonic atom cancels before physical inversion
assumptions: This is a pole of a local continued RESPONSE,not a nonreal eigenvalue of the self-adjoint physical Hamiltonian
Positive domain is defined by norm/Neumann/overlap conditions,not a numerical detuning tolerance
C31 alternative proof needs the preserved derivative MINUS sign and Schur inverse-domain clarification
costs: Unevaluated M_r,N_star,overlap Z_p and other norm conditions determine epsilon
All harmonic atoms/continua and all hard-core constraints retained;V is not replaced by a finite-rank model
Original contour roots are floating diagnostics,not validated pole enclosures or proof of membership in the qualitative eta radius
contract.units: Local outgoing continued pole at g=1/5;energy and detuning in hbar=B=1
contract.obstruction: No all-time exponential survival,finite-duration gate fidelity,usable numeric tolerance or uniform weak-g radius established.
